report: 53-year-old man with 7-year bilateral truncal nodules and positive Darier sign. Biopsy shows CD117/toluidine-blue-positive dermal mast cells, confirming mast cell disorder. Chronic skin-limited distribution, no systemic symptoms, and negative PET/CT favor cutaneous mastocytosis. Atypical B-cell infiltrate may be reactive and does not negate diagnosis. Final diagnosis: cutaneous mastocytosis.
